{{Quote|King Amand, we were just...|Garas, after being interrupted|<ref name="Lead by Example" />}}
'''Ral Garas''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] advisor to [[King/Legends|King]] [[Amand/Legends|Amand]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Molos/Legends|Molos]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], with the support of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Garas helped plan an [[Uprising on Molos/Legends|uprising]] on the planet with fellow advisor, Sergeant [[Trask (Rebel)/Legends|Trask]].<ref name="Lead by Example" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garas appears in the opening story in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Lead by Example]]''.<ref name="Lead by Example" />
